summary: The selected browser board shows its active physical groups, including empty sections. The existing selected-read transaction authorizes the grouped projection, and the shared rename operation locks both the addressed item and its active group. Native reads retain the flat item contract.
evidence: browser_opens_and_edits_grouped_board passed in headless Chromium. Board 201 showed Work / 2 items (73 Sketch, 61 Ink), Reserve / No Items, then Work / 1 item (59 Ink). F2 and Enter on 59 sent one successful selected-name PUT. Independent PostgreSQL reads showed only 59 changed to Coral/2; the archived 57, sibling board and scoped target retained their identities, positions, titles and revisions.

Reload kept the history entry and original session, resolved once and fetched 201 once. Returning to the list and selecting 202 showed only Work / 1 item with 62 Outline. The sections, counts and accepted edit matched the synthetic reference comparison in ROADMAP.md.

browser_grouped_board_rechecks_membership passed. Removing closed-workspace membership produced resolve 200 then GET 403, Destination unavailable and no sections. Restoring membership and choosing Retry destination fetched 201 once at the same entry and restored the read-only groups. No writes or second login; all revisions remained 1.

preview_groups_require_active_membership passed. A partial preview session could not read groups. Matched-session reads reflected current read/edit access. Grouped and native flat reads excluded archived content; valid PUTs to 57, newly archived 59 and an inactive scoped item returned 404 without a saved row. Independent readback confirmed unchanged records.

group_migration_preserves_flat_boards passed. Two production migrations over populated and empty version-2 boards retained one board-local main/Items group each and preserved ordered IDs, padded spelling and non-default revision. This compatibility group is a boardcraft choice. A new flat snapshot used the same group; a cross-board assignment failed its foreign key. The store returned 500 empty groups at its projection limit and rejected 501 without partial results.

All 12 browser_preview journeys and all 13 loopback_board_access tests passed serially. The locked workspace suite passed 28 tests using target-browser-packets. Workspace formatting and git diff --check passed. The worker shell denied node --test scripts/run.test.mjs before execution; runner regressions remain unverified here.
